description:
One product with the shops that sell it in a country and their offers (variants, colours) with
prices, cheapest first (the first 15 listed, all counted), by the product id search_products
returned (results of type "product"); pass the same country as that search. Use it to answer
where something is cheapest or to compare shops. Give the user the product's url: its
PriceBee page links to each shop.

country.description: The country to shop in: lt (Lithuania, default), lv (Latvia) or ee (Estonia).

product_id.description: The id of a search_products result of type "product".

name: get_product
title: Compare a product's prices
